prompt: A sprite sheet of eight animation frames laid out in a perfectly regular grid of 4 columns and 2 rows, each frame centred in its own equal cell with generous empty margin, read left to right and top to bottom, forming one smooth seamless loop (frame 8 leads back into frame 1).
